page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn2.3xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at 2.5 GHz with an x86_64 architecture. The instance is configured with 16 dedicated physical cores and 16 vCPUs, providing a 1:1 thread-to-core ratio. It includes 64.0 GB of system memory, yielding 4.0 GB of RAM per core. This instance does not include local storage or GPU accelerators, and it provides a baseline network bandwidth of 3 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates that the ecs.sn2.3xlarge exhibits average multi-core performance but weak single-core capabilities. In stress-ng and Geekbench tests, single-core CPU performance falls into the bottom 25%, and single-threaded gzip compression is in the bottom 10%. Conversely, multi-core benchmarks, including Geekbench multi-core, PassMark CPU, and multi-threaded bzip3 decompression, consistently rank in the middle 50%. Memory bandwidth tests for both small cached blocks and large uncached blocks also demonstrate average performance.

Given its dedicated CPU allocation and balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, this instance offers stable resource density for workloads that benefit from multi-threaded execution rather than raw single-core speed. It is suitable for multi-threaded applications, static web serving, Redis database operations, and software compilation. From a cost-efficiency perspective, the lack of bundled local storage and moderate network bandwidth position it as a standard utility option for general-purpose workloads requiring dedicated CPU resources without the premium cost of high-frequency or memory-optimized hardware.
